title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: Isaac Lab - Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable setup for building robotics simulation environments from interchangeable robots, objects, tasks, and scenes. It is aimed at quickly prototyping robot-learning tasks and evaluating policies across different embodiments and environment configurations, making it useful for scaling simulation coverage without rebuilding each setup from scratch.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: Getting Started with NVIDIA Cosmos 3 for Robotics and Physical AI | Cosmos Labs
summary: NVIDIA introduced Cosmos 3, the latest version of its world foundation model platform for robotics and physical AI. It supports world generation, synthetic data, simulation, and training workflows for robots, autonomous machines, digital twins, and agents that must understand and reason about physical environments, while integrating with NVIDIA’s broader ecosystem.

extra.full_text: Join NVIDIA for an introduction to Cosmos 3, the latest evolution of NVIDIA's world foundation model platform for physical AI. In this livestream, we'll explore what Cosmos 3 is, how it works, and why world foundation models are becoming a critical building block for robotics, autonomous systems, and AI applications that interact with the physical world. We'll cover the key concepts behind Cosmos 3, including world generation, synthetic data, simulation, and Physical AI training workflows, and show how it fits into the broader NVIDIA ecosystem. Whether you're developing robots, digital twins, autonomous machines, or AI agents that need to understand and reason about real-world environments, this session will provide a practical overview of Cosmos 3, its core capabilities, real-world applications, and how developers can get started today.
